theme: Minnesota gray wolves, coordinated tracking and long-distance pack calls: a large-eared pup becomes a lanky tracker, then a powerful quadrupedal wolf whose paired folded neck ruffs aim sound toward its ears. Its Dark typing expresses stealth and coordination; no ice, storms, moon emblems or costume.
habitat: Quiet forest trails and connected northern woodland clearings.
